name: enterprise_eval
description: Synthetic evaluation set for quality, grounding, safety, and adversarial behavior. Canaries and harmful-content strings are fake markers, not production secrets or operational instructions. reference_outcome records the expected status of the scripted system under test. Metrics do not read that field.
